en-US.description: Nvidia GPU exporter for prometheus using nvidia-smi binary
en-US.longDescription: Nvidia GPU exporter for prometheus, using the nvidia-smi binary to collect, parse and export GPU metrics. Supports running as a native Windows service.
en-US.name: Nvidia GPU Exporter
